title: Portfolio
text: Used React.js, Bootstrap, and CSS for an interactive frontend. JavaScript functions were implemented to fetch images and create individual cards by pulling data from a JSON file.

title: AniSim (In Progress)
text: Used React.js, Bootstrap, and CSS for the frontend and Node.js with Express.js and JavaScript for the backend, including user login. MySQL manages authentication. For NLP, I’m using Hugging Face’s transformers library in Python to analyze anime titles, integrating it with data from the AniList API.

title: Valentine Website
text: Created a Valentine's site with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS where hovering over the 'No' button makes it move away from the cursor.

title: ZotEvents
text: Used Selenium to scrape UCI Events page. Applies the Google Maps API to make finding UCI event locations easier. Uses React.js and CSS for front end, and JavaScript for backend.

title: Buzzr
text: This code creates a Discord bot using JavaScript, Node.js, and Discord.js to manage SMS notifications via the Twilio API. It uses SQLite for data storage and is currently handling a sports betting server with over 1,000 members, ensuring efficient and scalable communication.
